facts.fact: The document is headed Loi n°014-2024/ALT of 9 July 2024 on the security of information systems in Burkina Faso, setting rules to control and protect information systems and govern actors, with licensing and fines; the artefact is the committee text, and the enacted identity is stated in its provenance note (promulgation itself not shown in the text).
